items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Owens Plus the Rod Rogers Dance Company

ctx.x: With your group, Jimmy Owens Plus…, do you wanted to talk about some of the places you’ve travelled because I know you’ve been all over the world.

Okay, you know so, Jimmy Owens Plus, first of all, the title of my group comes from the fact that the plus was always something special that I was performing with. It could be Jimmy Owens Plus the Rochester Philharmonic Orchestra, or the Symphony of the New World Orchestra, Jimmy Owens Plus the Rod Rogers Dance Company. It could be Jimmy Owens Plus you the audience, so that’s how I came up with

the name. Lots of college concerts over the years, in all parts of the United States from about 1977. [I was] really getting active in Europe doing concerts, workshops, in all parts of Europe. [I did] jazz festivals. By 77 or 78, doing recordings with the quartet and the Hanover Radio Philharmonic in Germany. That was very, very rewarding. I have all of these recordings, they’re not for public consumption, they’re for the radio and the radio can’t put them out as a record unless they contact me and I cant put…
